put.description: Text is trimmed and empty means not set. The address is up to 200 characters, the description up to 500 and each link an `https://` address of up to 200. Phone numbers must belong to the configured region (`LK` by default) and are stored in E.164; the WhatsApp number must be a mobile number. A map position needs both coordinates, latitude -90 to 90 and longitude -180 to 180, and is rounded to six decimal places.
